clips.title: The story
paras: At Solliden Farmstead, human farmers still tend pumpkins in western Tirisfal Glades, just north of Deathknell. These native Lordaeronians survived the Plague of Undeath, a rare sight in northern Lordaeron, and hold fiercely to their soil beneath the Scarlet Crusade’s shadow.

Solliden Farmstead’s fields still yield healthy crops while much of Lordaeron lies in ruin and rot. The surviving human farmers are traumatized and insular, living beneath the watch of Scarlet Crusade patrols from a nearby tower. They defend their home with fierce hostility, striking at outsiders who come near, whether Horde or Alliance.

Forsaken rising from Deathknell see Solliden Farmstead as both a threat and a resource. The Royal Apothecary Society wants its pristine pumpkins as prime organic material for testing and brewing the New Plague. Forsaken officers such as Deathguard Simmer send fledgling recruits to raid the fields, steal pumpkins for Apothecary Johaan in Brill, and teach the living a lesson.
